title: Physical Digivice Game
author: brainlessziggy
selftext:
Sample video of the battle and capture loop.

TLDR: I wanted a Digivice my son and I could actually play with, so I put together a 3D-printed shell, a round touchscreen ESP32 board, and a custom Digimon game. We now have two of them and have been playtesting together.

AI Specifics: All 100% built and designed by OpenAI Dot (including 3d model and part list)

The idea was pretty simple. Let’s make something where you can walk around, encounter Digimon, battle, catch them, and work toward Digivolutions. All on a little device you can carry around.

I went with a D-Ark-inspired shell and a Waveshare ESP32-S3 round touchscreen board. Printed the case, assembled the electronics, and started working through how it should actually feel to use.

Right now it has:

\- Step-based wild encounters  
\- Battles and a timed capture minigame  
\- Care, XP, and Digivolutions  
\- A collection where you can change your partner  
Nearby battles and trading between devices

Basically trying to make it like a dedicated PokomonGo like device for Digimon

It’s still a work in progress. But my son ran around the house playing it for two hours, which was pretty much the whole reason I wanted to build it.
